name: Permanent Residence for an Unlimited Period

requirements.blocker_text: Held the 5-year permanent residence permit for at least 4 years.
requirements.fix_path: Hold 5-year permanent residence status continuously for 4 years.

requirement_groups.name: Long-term residence, 5 years' continuous legal residence

requirements.blocker_text: Legally resided in Slovakia for an uninterrupted period of at least 5 years (or equivalent residence in another EU member state under qualifying employment/protection categories).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous legal residence.

sources.title: IOM Migration Information Centre Slovakia -- permanent residence categories: 5-year permanent residence (family/interest-of-Slovakia grounds), unlimited permanent residence (after holding the 5-year permit for at least 4 years), and long-term residence (5 years' continuous legal residence, EU long-term-resident-status equivalent)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovakia). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-2 IOM sourced; Slovakia's own Ministry of Interior pages were not reachable to sufficient tier-1 depth in this pass. STRUCTURAL NOTE: Slovakia runs THREE distinct settled-status instruments the source describes -- 5-year permanent residence (family/discretionary grounds, modeled in sk_family_reunification.json), unlimited-duration permanent residence (this file's primary group, reached by holding the 5-year permit for 4 years), and a separate 'long-term residence' track requiring 5 years' continuous legal residence directly (this file's second group, functionally the EU long-term-resident-status route, likely the relevant path for work/business-permit holders who are not family of a Slovak citizen). Both groups are modeled here as alternative (OR) paths to the same indefinite settled outcome since they lead to materially similar rights, though they are legally distinct instruments -- flagged so the distinction isn't lost. citizenship_after_months is 0 from this status specifically since Slovakia's naturalisation residence requirement (8 years, see sk_citizenship_naturalisation.json) is typically satisfied by residence accumulated BEFORE and DURING earlier permit stages, not additionally after reaching this status -- though this is an inference, not a figure the source states directly.
